@@leveling3@@{{{leveling3}}}@@leveling4@@{{{leveling4}}}@@leveling5@@{{{leveling5}}}@@leveling6@@{{{leveling6}}}@@range@@{{{range}}}@@radius@@{{{radius}}}@@effectradius@@[[File:Range center.png|20px|link=Range|An icon representing the keyword Centered range]] 350@@width@@{{{width}}}@@speed@@{{{speed}}}@@casttime@@none@@cost@@15%@@cooldown@@28 / 25 / 22 / 19 / 16@@targeting@@Auto@@damagetype@@Magic@@spellshield@@@@projectile@@@@notes@@ * The first tick damages immediately so the final one occurs 0.5 seconds before '''Vladimir''' becomes targetable again. * There is an extra damage tick for [[Damage#0_Damage_Instances|0 damage]] when '''Vladimir''' becomes targetable again, triggering the same spell effects as the normal ticks (except those which require damage greater than 0 being dealt). ** This will trigger turret aggro onto '''Vladimir''' if an enemy champion is still within the effect radius when ''Sanguine Pool'' ends. * The [[File:Slow icon.png|20px|link=Slow|An icon representing the keyword Slow]] [[:Slow|slow]] ends immediately once affected enemies get out of range. * '''Vladimir''' can still use [[summoner spell|summoner spells]] and [[Active ability items|item actives]] during ''Sanguine Pool''. * While unable to attack, '''Vladimir''' can still input attack commands - causing him to follow his attack target. ** '''Vladimir's''' [[File:Range icon.png|15px|link=Range]] attack range is reduced「 to 0 」「 by 450 」while pooled - causing him to attempt to move right up to his attack target.@@
